requirements.general_text: Any one of these: SPM 5 credits including 3 Science subjects STPM (Science) with minimum CGPA of 2.50 UEC (minimum B5 in 3 Science subjects, B6 in other 2 other subjects and must have passed SPM) 3Ds in A-Level (Science) Foundation/Pre-University (Science) with CGPA of 2.5 or above Any equivalent Pre-U qualifications (Science)  Diploma in any Science discipline (CGPA of 2.75 or above) Diploma in Opticianry or Optical Dispensing (CGPA of 2.75 or above)
